It details the drop in output voltage of the sensors, which, in a way, is similar to that from a piezoelectric type sensor. Therefore the calibration was not as straightforward as expected. The paper details the circuit designed to filter, amplify and threshold the in-cylinder pressure signal and as a result issue the spark plug trigger. The paper outlines the successful implementation of these glow plugs on the free piston engine which resulted in better combustion events than in previous location-based spark triggers.

articleTitle: Design of High-Speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor for Advanced and Sensorless Control Techniques Validation
abstract: This paper presents a design of a high-speed (HS) permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) for advanced and sensorless control techniques validation. First, an electromechanical design of the motor is introduced. It consists of a rotor, a stator core and a motor housing design. FEM software is used for electromagnetic design and two different versions of the stator core are proposed. A key element of the design process is the feasibility of the motor manufacturing using materials available in the market for a single unit production. Therefore, to lower maintenance requirements and motor complexity, the stator core with lower power losses is chosen. To be able to operate the HS PMSM at a nominal speed suitable bearings are selected. For verification of control techniques such as a sensorless control, the motor is equipped with a 12-bit angular Hall encoder. The paper contains an overview of the manufacturing process and a price range of used components as well. After the manufacturing process, the Luenberger observer with quadrature phase locked loop is designed for the sensorless control of HS PMSM. The influence of time delays is reduced with a multisampled PWM and the algorithm is implemented on a FPGA and tested with the manufactured HS PMSM. The experimental results are analyzed for future improvements.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Predictive Control with Constraint Propagation Strategy
abstract: In the paper, new nonlinear predictive control method is proposed, that takes into consideration constraints on input and state variables. The method relies on a model obtained through feedback linearization. Quadratic cost function with state variables predicted from linear model is used. Constraints of the variables of nonlinear system are included by the use of constraints propagation to the variables of the linear model. In result, at every step of predictive control, quadratic cost function is minimized with linear constraints, providing control signals for nonlinear system. As example for application, system of four tanks is presented, that consists of two inputs and four state variables. Proposed control method is simulated on the model of this system. Results show that presented method, with finite prediction horizon, provides better performance than applied, with the same weighting matrices, linear quadratic control for linear model where constraints on inputs of nonlinear system are considered only by saturation function. Proposed method allows to obtain better prediction for inputs that are needed in future, the inputs stay shorter at their bounds in comparison to the results of linear quadratic control. The method reduces overshoot and settling time of state variables.

articleTitle: Testing of Autonomous High Precision Panel Assembly Process
abstract: In this paper, we present the testing of a novel panel fitting process. This process is based on least-square best-fitting, polynomial multi-regression based statistical estimation, and Greiner-Hormann polygon clipping quality checking methods, to ensure the gap and flush consistency in the final assembly. We focus on the multi-perception vision system, that consists of eight structured light sensors and a mechanical geometrical gripper. Verification and Validation of best-fitting method shows that: the maximum translation error in X and Z coordinate is less than 0.5 mm, in Y coordinate it is less than 2.5 mm, maximum rotation error in three coordinates is less than 0.2°, and it takes just 1.5 seconds to complete the process. The best-fitting method is robust, and meets the process requirements. Verification and Validation of estimation method, that serves as back-up support, shows that: with 3 iterations the translation and rotation errors in three coordinates are 2 mm and less than 2.5° respectively, and it takes 14.3 seconds to complete the process. However, it cannot meet the lead time requirement. This delay is due to the settling time of the prototype gripper between each iteration that is necessary to accommodate the prototype gripper inertia. A final geometric gripper with fixtures for the sensor will resolve this problem by introducing rigidity to the system. Overall, the propose process is a viable and practical solution for the panel fitting process.

articleTitle: Development of an Intelligent Human Resource Management System in the Era of Digitalization and Talentism
abstract: As it was pointed out at the Davos Forum, in the era of talentism, the company's prosperity will depend on human capital. However, human resources management is associated with the need to counter threats to the entire product lifecycle caused by the human factor. Managing labor risks is associated with the need for an individual assessment of the human resource, which is a very laborious task, requiring digitalization of this projects area. The article presents the developed concept of an assessment system and architecture of the labor risks module for project tasks. A mathematical model for calculating labor risks has been formulated, taking into account many factors of the Project Server corporate environment, external sources of corporate data, such as the electronic passes system and MS Outlook e-mail. Algorithms of the program module's operation to calculate resource and design indicators have been developed, and the general architecture of the system has been built. Logical and physical data models are designed, all information system's objects for calculating resource and design indicators are identified. The software implementation methods, the software platform and the environment for implementing the assigned tasks are described in the paper. The software interface of the VSTO add-in was developed, its functional purpose and software forms to operate and analyze the calculated data on resources and project tasks are described.

articleTitle: Processing Methods of Camera Record of Animal Movement

authors.preferredName: Ana Carolina D’Angeles M. de Brito

abstract: The aim of this paper is to introduce in detail methods for processing of visible-light digital camera records of animals in their natural environment to study animal movements. Two types of recordings have been used - videos from a stationary camera and videos from wearable camera on animal body. For this reason, two different data processing procedures are introduced. The first method allows determine the position of the animal in the space using a stationary camera. The second method allows determine the intensity of the animal's movement using wearable camera. The methods have been tested. The movement of cattle and dogs was recorded by cameras. A software has been designed in MatLab® to process videos and preprocess motion data for further study. A part of the work's results is thus a presentation of a method for monitoring and preprocessing animal's movements. The described methods and procedures have been developed according to the specific requirements for recording of animal movements. The assumption for the future is the application of methods and movement parameters for studying the function of the nervous system.

articleTitle: Swept Laser Based 3D Pose Detection of the Swinging Robot Acroboter
abstract: Domestic robots have been attracted growing interest. The Acroboter is a ceiling based crane-like robot concept, which utilizes the entire cubic volume of indoor environments. The benefits of cranes and drones are combined in our concept: the fan actuators make the robot agile in the horizontal direction, and the hoist rope provides the suspending force without power input when the robot is still. The lightweight structure is composed of 3D printed components and carbon balsa composite sandwich base plate. Our novel pose detection approach is to attach the HTC Vive measurement unit rigidly to the swinging unit of the robot. The working principle is based on sweeping beams of laser and time measurement providing high accuracy. We demonstrate in experiments that this novel pose detection concept is feasible for robots and it is accurate and fast enough for achieving stable trajectory tracking control of our crane-like manipulator.

articleTitle: Implementation of nSoric measuring system on a PLC
abstract: The aim of this paper is to propose the implementation of the existing complex measuring system nSoric for measurement of physical quantities into the environment of programmable logic PLCs. This system will be used to measure the temperature profile in transport structures in the horizontal and vertical directions. Part of the work is the selection of suitable sensors for temperature measurement and suggestion of their encapsulation with respect to the physico-chemical conditions in the transportation constructions. The arrangement and connection of the temperature sensors is selected with regard to the amount of wiring used. The PLC control system communicates with the nSoric metering system, displays the measured data on the operator panel, and when is ensured connection to the ethernet network, it also makes it available to personal computers via the web interface. The user can identify and arrange individual sensors with the choice of each sensor's name. Processed proposal of temperature measurement can contribute to road safety by monitoring road conditions. Using PLC simplifies installation of the nSoric metering system, enables it to integrate into various automated systems, and improves process control in industry.

articleTitle: Flow Detection using an Artificial Vibrissa-Like Sensor – Simulations and Experiments
abstract: Several animal species like rats or seals explore the surrounding environment with their sensory hairs, the so-called vibrissae. Regarding to natural vibrissa, the functionalities of tactile object sensing to receive information about, e.g., the shape and/or the surface texture are often discussed. But, the usage of natural vibrissae to detect flows is reported as well. The necessary information about the flow are coded in the signals recorded at the base of the vibrissa. Due to the natural paragon, we adapt this behavior in order to show up how the information about flows can be extracted from these observables. This is an important procedure because the detection and determination of information about flow effects become interesting for several reasons. For example, in the case of other sensing tasks and strategies like object contour scanning, flows are considered as (possible) disturbances that have to be known to reconstruct any sensed boundary. Otherwise, the flow itself can be of interest. In a first step, simulations are performed to examine the relations between the observables at the base of the sensor and the applied velocity of a flow. Here, a steady-state uniform flow is assumed. The simulations are validated by experiments.

articleTitle: Postural Control During Standing Posture For Small Perturbations With Feedback Linearization
abstract: Postural balance and stability is a complex neuromuscular task and it requires coordination among different limbs and body parts. The maintenance of balance in upright stance isn't yet completely comprehended and difficulties because of insufficiency in the postural control are of significant concern. The postural control mechanism combines highly nonlinear musculoskeletal structure together with neural control and tactile system in human body. Searching for a model for a more noteworthy comprehension of human postural control framework, this paper displays another computational model committed to the investigation of human upright stance. In this paper we propose a nonlinear control method in light of feedback linearization to imitate the control activity of central nervous system (CNS) in support of postural balance. We use 4-segments biomechanical model with 3 degrees-of-freedom and with rotation about ankle, knee and hip joints. The output feedback is computed with feedback linearization augmented with LQR. The feedback gains are optimized with physiological relevant optimization based on center of mass (COM) and ground reaction forces (GRF). The active and passive torques involved in postural stabilization are computed from reference trajectories and output feedbacks respectively. These torque profiles settle the motion profiles within human anatomical constraints.

articleTitle: Investigation into the Moment of Inertia Estimation Process Occurring in Electric Drive of a Mechatronic System
abstract: The subject of the paper is research into the knowledge about the errors sources occurring in the moment of inertia estimation process taking place in the automatic speed control subsystems operating in the mechatronic systems. The new estimator structure containing the data selection subsystem is proposed and tested with simulation investigations. As the result, the significant 100-fold error reduction in the moment of inertia estimation process is obtained.

articleTitle: Optimization of Industrial Robot Trajectory in Composite Production
abstract: Currently, traditional materials (e.g. iron, steel, aluminium alloy, wood) are increasingly being replaced by composites in many industrial areas. The main advantages of these new materials are their light weight, high strength and flexibility, corrosion resistance, long lifespan and the reduced price of the produced components. This article discusses the quality of the manufacturing process technology of a shaped composite in 3D space. The technology used is based on a winding of carbon filaments on a polyurethane frame with a circular cross-section (this type of composites is used, for example, in automotive chassis). One important factor in composite frame quality is making the correct winding angles of fibres on the frame and the homogeneity of the individual winding layers. The composite frame is attached to the end-effector of the robot and successively passes through the fibre-processing head during the winding process with three layers. Each layer of fibres is wound at a different angle (usually at π/4, 0 and - π/4). The mathematical model of the winding process and the matrix calculus (especially matrices of rotations, translates and calculations of Euler angles) are used to determine the optimized 3D trajectory of end-effector in this paper. The differential evolution algorithm is applied to finding the optimized 3D trajectory of the end-effector. In this way the winding angles and homogeneity of winding layers are maintained during production of the frame composite. The optimized end-effector trajectory is defined by calculated sequence of tool-centre-point values. The calculation of optimized trajectory is programmed and tested in the Delphi development environment. This approach to determining the optimized trajectory of the robot is substantially more effective than the repeated search of a suitable trajectory using the control panel (teach pendant) of the robot.

articleTitle: Reduced Schwarz-Christoffel Conformal Mapping in Surface-Mounted PMSM
abstract: Schwarz-Christoffel conformal mapping method is widely used in modeling of air gap flux density distribution of electrical machines. It should not be as time consuming as definition and calculation of the finite element model but provides results with high accuracy. Also the improved saturation model can be applied to obtain more accurate results. In this paper, the reduced Schwarz-Christoffel conformal mapping is presented to minimize the calculated region area. The conformal mapping is used only once and then the air gap magnetic field can be derived for all rotor positions and stator current phase shift.
